entities.summary: 1945-1946 armed conflict involving a largely british-indian and french task force and japanese troops from the southern expeditionary army group, versus the vietnamese communist movement, the viet minh Took place in Southern Vietnam. Date: 1945-09-13. Ended: 1946-03-30.
